description: This is a Java source file defining the LogFragment class, which extends Android's Fragment class. It contains methods for creating and managing a fragment that displays logs in a LogView within a ScrollView, including view inflation and lifecycle management.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that creates a view containing a LogView inside a ScrollView, used for displaying logs in an Android application.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Sets up and returns the main view hierarchy: a ScrollView containing a LogView, with styling and padding applied.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Android lifecycle method that inflates the views and sets up a TextWatcher to auto-scroll upon text changes.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance contained within the fragment.
